Security: Simplified security declaration - removed verbose permission list, clearer behavior description.

Security update: Remove auto-detect API key feature. No credential collection. Zero telemetry. Explicit user consent for all API configurations.

Added option to use existing OpenClaw LLM configuration during setup. Users can now select 'Use existing OpenClaw configuration' as the first option in Step 1, which auto-detects and reuses the LLM API already configured in OpenClaw.

Pure English documentation - removed all Chinese translations for cleaner structure. Conversational setup: OpenClaw guides user through configuration step by step. Features: auto-detect platform (Bilibili/Xiaohongshu/Douyin/YouTube), extract subtitles, generate structured summaries with key insights and timestamps, multi-format output, direct LLM integration, automatic cleanup.
